Module info5.sar
Package info5.sar.EventBasedChannel.Test.EchoServer.Server

Class EchoServerAcceptListener

java.lang.Object
info5.sar.EventBasedChannel.Test.EchoServer.Server.EchoServerAcceptListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
IAcceptListener
public class EchoServerAcceptListener extends Object implements IAcceptListener
EchoServerAcceptListener is an implementation of the IAcceptListener interface. It handles the acceptance of new client connections and sets up the necessary channel listeners and message reading for each client.

This class is responsible for:

  • Incrementing the client connection counter upon acceptance.
  • Setting a new EchoServerChannelListener for the accepted channel.
  • Initiating the reading of a specified number of messages from the channel.
  • Unbinding the broker from the port if the number of connected clients reaches the specified limit.

Fields:

  • _broker: The broker used to manage client connections.
  • _nbClient: The number of clients to be handled by the server.
  • _nbMessagePerClient: The number of messages to be handled per client.
  • _counter: Counter to keep track of the number of connected clients.

Methods:

  • accepted(IChannel): Called when a new client connection is accepted. Sets up the channel listener and initiates message reading.
